title: Unify native profile resolution while preserving existing installations on every supported platform
goal: Remove repeated platform directory selection and verify every original typed profile and service fallback, including non-UTF paths, distinct Windows roots and legacy layouts.

reuse.searched: The existing platform directory resolver, native path validation, temporary instance guard and public SusiDirs callers retain their original OS rules. Share the existing config, data and cache lookup rather than adding a directory library.
